## Purpose
The observability package: traces of every action, exported to Mistral. It re-exports the tracing API.

## Responsibilities
Re-exports from `tracing`: GEN_AI_WORKFLOW_NAME, annotate, current_trace_id, enabled, event_span, execution_trace_hex, flush, instrument_client, mark_error, set_attrs, setup, shutdown, span and start_detached.
